Titles.eng: Free! Road to the World - Yume
Titles.jpn: 劇場版 Free! -Road to the World-夢

Summaries.eng: Haruka, who is attending college in Tokyo, meets Asahi again and reawakens his memories from his middle school years, including those of Ikuya. Makoto is working toward a new dream while he is in Tokyo together with Haruka. Rin has an unexpected meeting in Sydney.
